MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The small drill bits fit my recent screws and fasteners because they could help me make holes for the same kinds of DIY assembly tasks.",
    "The duct tape fits my interest in practical repair supplies, although I would only choose it when I had an immediate repair to make."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "COVID tests, masks and examination gloves do not help with the hardware tasks suggested by my recent purchases, and I have no current need for them.",
    "Wire harness tape, heat shrink tubing and silicone oil each require a specific task I have not indicated; buying fasteners and magnetic hooks does not mean I am working on wiring or lubrication.",
    "Bulk trash bags and a thousand disposable gloves assume a scale of work and a need for consumables that my recent purchases do not establish."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat supplies that might be used in a workplace as interchangeable with tools and hardware for my projects.",
    "My interest in practical hardware seems to have been stretched into an assumed need for general maintenance, electrical and protective supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases point more directly toward small fastening, mounting and hanging tasks, so items that help with those tasks feel more relevant.",
    "I rarely choose something merely because it could be useful someday; I need a clear connection to something I am doing now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in DIY hardware but stretched it into unrelated supplies without a clear current use."
}
